name: mirage
text: You were right again, and here's why: of 51 legs only 9 were finished-but-ungraded (7 tennis moneylines, 2 college basketball), and my first fix skipped them because those legs had lost their Novig market id. I fixed that (it now grades every finished leg from the final score, including legs of already-settled parlays) and restarted the engine at 02:49 UTC. In about 5 minutes I'll check each of those 9 legs by name and tell you which ones got a result; tennis names like 'Ben Shelton N/A' may not match and I'll say so if any don't.
